'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Veasey LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|VB4-L-angerfearaggression-pre.gif|label=Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)}}
* '''Username:''' veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
